description: Sentinel for DTR scenario 11, a request the service rejects with HTTP 400. A Medicare member with active coverage, so a tester who looks the sentinel up before the run is shown a member and not a finding about test data. The lookup itself succeeds: the fault this scenario is for is in the DTR call.
basis: Synthetic. Every value in this file is invented and no real member was used to make it. The shape of the response is one the mapping tolerates, not one observed from the member API, whose contract is not final.
